sections.content: Opinions can take the indicative when the speaker presents the proposition as asserted. Negative or uncertain expressions of opinion commonly trigger the subjunctive when the proposition is rejected or not asserted.

items.spanish: Creo que estudiar en grupo es útil.
items.english: I think studying in a group is useful.

items.spanish: No creo que estudiar solo sea siempre mejor.
items.english: I don't think studying alone is always better.

items.spanish: Es posible que este método sea eficaz.
items.english: It is possible that this method is effective.

sections.content: *Creo* *que* normally presents the following proposition as asserted. No creo que and expressions of uncertainty normally use the subjunctive.
